hero_questions.1_deliberate_silhouette: PARTIAL FAIL — staged keep and different towers improve Source01, but the family still reads first as a long crenellated wall band.
hero_questions.2_immediately_dominant_valoria_bastion: FAIL — the central keep is clearer but not yet iconic enough to dominate the whole family at gameplay distance.
hero_questions.3_primary_secondary_tertiary: PASS DIRECTIONALLY — keep/command masses, recessed curtain bays and tertiary crenellation are more legible.
hero_questions.4_real_architectural_depth: PASS — recessed curtain bays, projecting piers and staged keep/tower sections create genuine depth.
hero_questions.5_controlled_asymmetry: PASS — east tower, far-west block and left wing have distinct skyline roles.
hero_questions.6_no_cloned_modules: PASS — tower section logic is visibly different.
hero_questions.7_rich_material_without_microdetail: PARTIAL — low-frequency stone fixes Source01 brick dominance, but lit review is too dark/muddy for a hero focal asset.
hero_questions.8_coherent_lower_gate_walls: PASS — same military stone language, richer hierarchy.
hero_questions.9_gameplay_camera: FAIL HERO — from the gameplay-facing preview the keep and access still do not create the premium focal read required.
hero_questions.10_authored_not_procedural: PASS — geometry is deliberately authored and semantically staged.
hero_questions.11_not_castle_kit_generic: FAIL HERO — improved, but silhouette still resembles a competent generic crenellated fortress strip rather than an unmistakable Valoria landmark.
hero_questions.12_obvious_full_frame_improvement: FAIL HERO BAR — clear improvement over blockout, not yet enough for the dominant landmark.

decision: DO NOT INTEGRATE UNITY. Source03 must create one unmistakable command keep/access signature at large scale, brighter limestone hierarchy, and more narrative asymmetric crest/damage while preserving every approved envelope.
legacy_reference_note: Historical certified Hero Bastion was inspected only as a quality/reference donor. It is richer but too vertical/palatial/blue-roofed for the current canonical target and will NOT be substituted as final geometry.
